_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); cruise-line signals

pit_profile.why: Royal Caribbean: 'Together, our Global Brands and our Partner Brands operate a combined total of 61 ships in the cruise vacation industry with an aggregate capacity of approximately 137,930 berths as of December 31, 2020'; 'Our principal competitors are Carnival Corporation & plc'; 'We may lose business to competitors throughout the vacation market'; and 'In addition to health and safety concerns, demand for cruises is affected by international, national, and local economic conditions' (its own FY2020 10-K): a cruise-fleet franchise whose demand follows the economies it sells into, by its own account; no disruption theme is live for it

classification.quality_note: Royal Caribbean: 'Together, our Global Brands and our Partner Brands operate a combined total of 61 ships in the cruise vacation industry with an aggregate capacity of approximately 137,930 berths as of December 31, 2020'; 'Our principal competitors are Carnival Corporation & plc'; 'We may lose business to competitors throughout the vacation market'; and 'In addition to health and safety concerns, demand for cruises is affected by international, national, and local economic conditions' (its own FY2020 10-K): a cruise-fleet franchise whose demand follows the economies it sells into, by its own account; no disruption theme is live for it. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price cheap; Ratio B 0.14x; -29% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -0.01; conservative 2yr +82%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -27.1%/yr (worst year FY11-FY19, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +-74.4%/yr (nine months revenues + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr ex-FY20 median

BULL.desc: EPS +16.7%/yr (FY11-FY19 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +40.7%/yr (best 2-yr run FY11-FY19); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: RCL (retrospective, 2021-11-26) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.14x (27.9% downside to Bear $49 / +204.5% upside to Bull $207) | Adj composite 2.20 vs market 2.21: gap -0.01 [FAIRLY VALUED] | -29% above the EPP floor $95 (10x FY21E $9.54) | Conservative 2-yr case: +82.4% total (+41.2%/yr) | At 7.1x FY21E the 15% hurdle price $90 sits between the BASE and BULL cases; Net Yields n/r in Q3 2021, forward net revenue -74.7% (no FY21 guide in numbers, 2021's nine months revenues); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
